settings.tagline: The GraphQL-first headless CMS in a single Rust binary
settings.description: Tess is a self-hostable, GraphQL-first headless CMS written in Rust. Define content models at runtime, publish with review workflows, and run it on Docker, a VM or AWS Lambda.
settings.footerText: © 2026 Tess Dev Team. Community edition for personal use, Enterprise edition for commercial use.

data.title: Tess vs Sanity
data.description: Tess compared with Sanity (Hosted content platform with an open-source studio): A hosted Content Lake with a customizable, open-source React editing studio and its own query language, GROQ.

competitor.chooseThem: - You need real-time collaboration and a deeply customized editing studio.
competitor.chooseTess: - You want your content in your own database, with a standard GraphQL API and no query language to learn.
competitor.migration: Sanity document types and objects map to Tess content types and components; arrays of mixed types become `DYNAMIC_ZONE` fields. Import the models with `tess-transfer`, then copy documents from a Sanity export through the Tess GraphQL API.
